Review NE same-facing ankle posture, leg/foot attachment, sole contact and ground baseline before barefoot, flat-shoe or any footwear acceptance. Do not mirror, deform or overwrite approved limbs.
futureBodyFitObligations: Check the circled neck/shoulder hair starts against actual independently authored same-facing body and clothing layers.
Rear hair must sit behind the torso/shoulders where physically appropriate; intentional foreground curls retain their proper depth.
Inspect real native-layer composition for exposed abrupt starts and mask seams. Do not move inspection panels, clip valid hair or use a stand-in torso to certify production fit.
If any abrupt starts remain visible after the true body composition, repair them in a new version.
futureHairstyleFitObligations: SE and SW anatomy ears differ in apparent size in the bare-head review. Current reference hair conceals this discrepancy; approval does not establish compatibility with alternate hairstyles. Before shorter/open-ear hairstyles or ear-size variants are accepted, compare native ear proportions, attachment and exposure across independently authored facings and review the actual layered fit. If exposed differences look incoherent, author versioned corrections rather than silently scaling or mirroring approved ears.
futureAuthoringNote: Eventually we may want to create asset by asset from scratch when given a design to avoid this masking problem as long as the layering system works.
